name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Mix oats, milk and chia. Refrigerate overnight. Top with sliced banana and honey.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in a bowl. Drizzle honey.

name: Scrambled Eggs & Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk. Cook in oiled pan on low heat, stirring gently. Serve on toast.

name: Protein Smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Drink immediately.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa per package. Grill chicken. Roast veg at 200C 20 min. Assemble bowl, drizzle lemon oil.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add lentils, tomatoes, water, cumin. Simmer 20 min.

name: Tuna Avocado Wrap
instructions: Mix tuna with mashed avocado and lemon. Fill wrap with lettuce and tuna mix. Roll tight.

name: Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: Press tofu, cube and pan-fry until golden. Stir-fry veg, add tofu, soy sauce, ginger. Serve on rice.

name: Salmon & Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake sweet potato 35 min 200C. Season salmon, pan-fry 4 min each side. Steam asparagus. Plate with lemon.

name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Heat beans with cumin. Warm tortillas. Fill with beans, avocado, salsa, cilantro, lime.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into bowl. Top with berries, walnuts and cinnamon.

name: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Rinse chickpeas. Dice veg. Toss all with oil, lemon, and parsley. Season.

name: Turkey Meatballs & Pasta
instructions: Mix turkey, egg, herbs, form balls. Pan-fry 8 min. Cook pasta. Simmer sauce, add meatballs, toss pasta.

name: Edamame & Brown Rice
instructions: Cook rice. Steam edamame. Combine, drizzle soy, top with sesame and spring onion.

name: Hard-Boiled Eggs & Fruit
instructions: Boil eggs 10 min. Peel. Serve with sliced fruit.

name: Beef & Broccoli
instructions: Slice beef thin. Stir-fry on high heat 2 min. Remove. Fry garlic, add broccoli, sauces. Add beef back.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon, salt, chili. Spread on toast.

name: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs. Sauté veg in oil. Pour eggs over veg, cook edges then fold. Top with feta.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Rice Cakes
instructions: Spread peanut butter on rice cakes. Top with sliced banana.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken, slice. Toss lettuce with dressing. Add croutons, parmesan, chicken.

name: Keto Egg Cups
instructions: Preheat 180C. Layer bacon in muffin tin. Add spinach, crack egg over. Top with cheese. Bake 15 min.

name: Keto Avocado Chicken Salad
instructions: Cube cooked chicken. Mash avocado. Mix with mayo, celery, lemon. Combine with chicken.

name: Steak & Eggs
instructions: Season steak. Cook in hot cast iron 3-4 min per side. Rest. Fry eggs in butter.

name: Paleo Turkey Bowl
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes 25 min 200C. Cook turkey with garlic until browned. Sauté kale. Assemble bowl.

name: Mediterranean Hummus Plate
instructions: Arrange hummus, sliced veg, olives on a plate. Drizzle olive oil. Serve with pita.

name: Post-Workout Protein Shake
instructions: Blend all. Drink within 30 min of training.

name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
instructions: Cook rice. Roast chickpeas and sweet potato 200C 25 min. Massage kale with oil. Assemble, drizzle tahini.

name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
instructions: Blend all ingredients. Cook small pancakes in non-stick pan 2-3 min each side. Serve with berries.

name: Shrimp & Zucchini Noodles
instructions: Spiralize zucchini. Sauté garlic, add shrimp 3 min. Add tomatoes, zoodles 2 min. Top with basil.

name: Halal Lamb Kofta Bowl
instructions: Mix lamb, grated onion, spices. Form koftas. Grill 10 min. Cook bulgur. Serve with yogurt and mint.

name: Kosher Quinoa Veggie Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa. Roast broccoli 200C 20 min. Combine, add chickpeas, dressing, pomegranate.

name: Pre-Workout Banana & Almond Butter
instructions: Slice banana. Dip in almond butter. Eat 30-60 min before training.

name: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Sauté peppers, add all other ingredients. Simmer 30 min. Season.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
instructions: Toast bagel. Spread cream cheese. Layer salmon, capers, onion. Squeeze lemon.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
instructions: Pulse cauliflower to rice. Stir-fry veg and garlic. Add cauliflower rice, soy sauce. Push aside, scramble eggs in. Combine.

name: High-Protein French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, protein powder, cinnamon. Dip bread. Cook 3 min per side. Drizzle syrup.

name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
instructions: Blanch green beans. Arrange all on a plate. Drizzle vinaigrette.

name: Mango Chia Pudding
instructions: Mix chia with coconut milk. Refrigerate 4h or overnight. Top with diced mango, honey, lime.

name: Chicken Tikka
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, lemon, garlic 2h. Grill or bake 200C 25 min.

name: Egg White Omelette
instructions: Whisk egg whites, season. Cook in sprayed pan, add veg when half-set. Fold. Serve immediately.

name: Poha
instructions: Rinse poha and drain. Heat oil, splutter mustard seeds with peanuts and curry leaves. Add onion and chilli; sauté 2 min. Add turmeric and poha, mix gently for 3 min. Finish with lemon juice and chopped coriander.

name: Idli with Sambar
instructions: Steam idlis 12 min until fluffy. Cook dal soft, add veg, tamarind, sambar masala; simmer 10 min. Temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves. Serve hot.

name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Sauté mustard, onion, chilli, turmeric. Mash potatoes in. Spread batter on hot tawa; drizzle oil, cook until crisp. Place filling, fold and serve.

name: Upma
instructions: Dry-roast semolina 3 min. Heat ghee, splutter mustard with curry leaves. Add veg, sauté 3 min. Pour water, salt; stir in semolina, cover 4 min.

name: Besan Chilla
instructions: Whisk besan with water and spices to pancake consistency. Mix in veg. Spread on hot pan, drizzle oil, flip after 2 min. Repeat for second chilla.

name: Aloo Paratha with Curd
instructions: Mix mashed potato with onion, chilli, salt. Stuff into rolled-out dough. Cook on tawa with ghee both sides until golden. Serve with curd.

name: Sprouted Moong Salad
instructions: Lightly steam sprouts 3 min (optional). Toss with veg, lemon, chaat masala, coriander.

name: Masala Oats
instructions: Sauté mustard, onion, veg in oil 3 min. Add tomato, turmeric, water; simmer 2 min. Stir in oats, cook 4 min until thick.

name: Dal Tadka with Rice
instructions: Pressure-cook dal with turmeric 3 whistles. Sauté cumin, onion, ginger-garlic, tomato in ghee. Add dal, simmer 5 min. Serve over steamed rice.

name: Rajma Chawal
instructions: Pressure-cook rajma 4 whistles. Sauté onion, ginger-garlic, tomato, masala. Add rajma with water, simmer 15 min. Serve with rice.

name: Khichdi
instructions: Rinse rice + dal. Pressure-cook with veg, turmeric, salt, water (1:4) for 3 whistles. Temper with ghee, cumin, hing; pour over.

name: Paneer Bhurji with Roti
instructions: Sauté onion till soft, add tomato and chilli; cook 4 min. Add crumbled paneer and garam masala; stir 3 min. Serve with hot rotis.

name: Chicken Curry with Rice
instructions: Brown onion, add ginger-garlic, tomato, masalas; cook 5 min. Add chicken, sear 4 min. Add water, simmer 25 min. Serve over rice.

name: Egg Curry with Roti
instructions: Sauté onion till golden, add ginger-garlic, tomato, masala; cook 4 min. Add water for gravy; simmer 5 min. Slip in eggs, simmer 3 min. Serve with rotis.

name: Roasted Chana Snack
instructions: Toss roasted chana with black salt, lemon juice, optional onion slices. Eat fresh.
